partSheetMetal.description: What persists on the assembly part row. sku is the key; the rest is a display snapshot so a reload without the network still shows material and thickness.

gauge.description: Sheet gauge, when the SKU has one.

script.note: Sheet Metal mode writes this marked block. It replaces the starter cube rather than adding onto an existing part.

spec.comment:
spec = {
  v: 1, sku, t (mm), r (inner bend radius mm), k (k-factor),
  limits: { …mm / deg from the SKU, see sheetLimitsFromRecord },
  plane: 'XY' | 'XZ' | 'YZ', width, height,          // base flange (centered)
  bends: [{ id, panel: 'base' | bendId, edge: 'u+'|'u-'|'v+'|'v-', angle, length, flip }],
  tabs:  [{ id, panel, edge, width, depth, centered, offset }],
  holes: [{ id, panel, u, v, d, kind: 'hole'|'countersink'|'tapped' }],
}

fields.limits: mm / deg limits copied from the SKU (sheetLimitsFromRecord) so DFM works offline.
fields.bends: [{ id, panel: 'base' | bendId, edge: 'u+'|'u-'|'v+'|'v-', angle, length, flip }]
fields.tabs: [{ id, panel, edge, width, depth, centered, offset }]
fields.holes: [{ id, panel, u, v, d, kind: 'hole'|'countersink'|'tapped' }]

dfm.note: Limits and the spec stay in millimetres. unit only formats messages. Hard fails block export and order in the app; warnings do not.

rules.check: The sheet spec did not parse.
The spec did not solve to a foldable sheet (solver error).
Bends on a SKU whose catalog record has no bending service.
Flange length is below the SKU min flange length after the bend.
Bend angle is outside the SKU min … max bend angle.
Bend line is longer than the SKU max bend length.
Hole diameter is below the SKU min hole size.
Hole edge is closer to a free panel edge than the SKU minimum, or the hole leaves its face.
Tapped hole centre is closer to a bend line than the SKU minimum (fail), or any hole edge is within 2.5·t + r of a bend (warn).
Tapped hole centre is closer to a bend line than the SKU minimum (fail), or any hole edge is within 2.5·t + r of a bend (warn).
Web between two holes on one panel is below the SKU min bridge, or the holes overlap.
Tab width or depth is below max(thickness, min bridge). Warning only.
Flat pattern is outside the SKU min / max flat size (bent) or part size (flat).
Exact bends could not be built; STEP fell back to the faceted mesh. Warning, from the exporter.
With the mesh fallback, built volume differs from the spec volume by more than 5%. Warning.
The part script has code outside the sheet-metal block. DXF and STEP come from the spec. Warning.

export.entry: buildSheetExport(spec, { mesh, script, partName, timestamp, exactStep, unit })
export.step: exactStep true (default) builds an AP214 B-rep with real cylinders at bends (sheetBrep.js → brepToStep). exactStep false, or a spec that cannot fold, falls back to meshToStep (faceted).
export.dxf: Flat pattern DXF from the spec (sheetFlat.js), not from the mesh.
export.headless: src/lib/surfcad/export.js sheetSpecToStep(spec) returns the same STEP text.
